title: Topic Binding
description: Mapping between a Telegram routing target (a forum topic or a private chat) and exactly one project. It is the routing key and the concurrency key. A binding that cannot be resolved is a refusal, never a fallback to another project.

kind.description: forum-topic requires topicId; private-chat forbids it.

chatId.description: Opaque identifier of the private chat or forum supergroup.

topicId.description: Forum topic identifier. The General topic is not a project binding and is excluded by the minimum.

projectPath.description: Absolute project path this binding routes to. Declared explicitly to Remote Entry on every submission; never inferred.

state.description: absent means Telegram reported the topic does not exist and the binding is cleared. inconclusive means the check failed transiently; the binding is left untouched and must not be cleared.

detail.description: Safe explanation. No raw provider error body.

maxDepth.description: Exceeding this is an explicit refusal, never a silent drop.
